title: 320 million young people, 110 million jobs
discussion_signal: The post frames the youth employment challenge as requiring strategic investment in skills, entrepreneurship, infrastructure, and high-potential sectors. Discussion adds creative industries, digital infrastructure, and women’s entrepreneurship, linking jobs to capability and inclusion rather than growth alone.
linked_research_question: Which sectors, skills, and institutions convert a large youth cohort into inclusive employment rather than economic pressure?
limits: Job projections are not realized employment outcomes
The discussion does not compare country implementation capacity
